testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect metric and inch part templates: tmp/obk-creation-new/features/application/document-creation/document-creation.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect metric and inch part templates ✔ Given a document is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And template grouping by document type is enabled ✔ When the user presses Control+N ✔ Then the new-document template chooser opens ✔ And templates are grouped by document type ✔ When the user selects the metric template folder ✔ And the user selects the standard metric part template ✔ Then the template details identify a part with millimeter units ✔ When the user selects the English template folder ✔ And the user selects the standard inch part template ✔ Then the template details identify a part with inch units
